faqs.question: Can I work on a student visa in Schengen?
faqs.answer: Often limited hours — country-specific. Not a work permit substitute.

faqs.question: Can work replace blocked account?

body:
Answer: Many student residences allow limited part-time work, but hours and rules differ by country. You must not depend on illegal work to “make” your funds proof. Check the destination’s student work rules after you know the permit type.

Safe planning

  • Show lawful living funds first
  • Treat part-time work as optional buffer
  • Never enter as a visitor to work
